1Co.14.32.kjv: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.

1Co.9.24.bsb: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one receives the prize? Run in such a way as to take the prize.
1Co.9.24.kjv: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.

1Co.13.10.bsb: but when the perfect comes, the partial passes away.
1Co.13.10.kjv: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.

1Co.1.30.bsb: It is because of Him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God: our righteousness, holiness, and redemption.
1Co.1.30.kjv: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption:

1Co.1.8.bsb: He will sustain you to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
1Co.1.8.kjv: Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

1Co.6.3.bsb: Do you not know that we will judge angels? How much more the things of this life!
1Co.6.3.kjv: Know ye not that we shall judge angels? how much more things that pertain to this life?

1Co.6.13.bsb: “Food for the stomach and the stomach for food,” but God will destroy them both. The body is not intended for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
1Co.6.13.kjv: Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats: but God shall destroy both it and them. Now the body is not for fornication, but for the Lord; and the Lord for the body.

1Co.6.15.bsb: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and unite them with a prostitute? Never!
1Co.6.15.kjv: Know ye not that your bodies are the members of Christ? shall I then take the members of Christ, and make them the members of an harlot? God forbid.

1Co.6.17.bsb: But he who unites himself with the Lord is one with Him in spirit.
1Co.6.17.kjv: But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit.

1Co.6.18.bsb: Flee from sexual immorality. Every other sin a man can commit is outside his body, but he who sins sexually sins against his own body.
1Co.6.18.kjv: Flee fornication. Every sin that a man doeth is without the body; but he that committeth fornication sinneth against his own body.

1Co.10.16.bsb: Is not the cup of blessing that we bless a participation in the blood of Christ? And is not the bread that we break a participation in the body of Christ?
1Co.10.16.kjv: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?

1Co.4.1.bsb: So then, men ought to regard us as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God.
1Co.4.1.kjv: Let a man so account of us, as of the ministers of Christ, and stewards of the mysteries of God.

1Co.4.2.bsb: Now it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
1Co.4.2.kjv: Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful.

1Co.3.1.bsb: Brothers, I could not address you as spiritual, but as worldly—as infants in Christ.
1Co.3.1.kjv: And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, even as unto babes in Christ.

1Co.4.6.bsb: Brothers, I have applied these things to myself and Apollos for your benefit, so that you may learn from us not to go beyond what is written. Then you will not take pride in one man over another.
1Co.4.6.kjv: And these things, brethren, I have in a figure transferred to myself and to Apollos for your sakes; that ye might learn in us not to think of men above that which is written, that no one of you be puffed up for one against another.

1Co.4.7.bsb: For who makes you so superior? What do you have that you did not receive? And if you did receive it, why do you boast as though you did not?
1Co.4.7.kjv: For who maketh thee to differ from another? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive? now if thou didst receive it, why dost thou glory, as if thou hadst not received it?

1Co.6.1.bsb: If any of you has a grievance against another, how dare he go to law before the unrighteous instead of before the saints!
1Co.6.1.kjv: Dare any of you, having a matter against another, go to law before the unjust, and not before the saints?

1Co.6.4.bsb: So if you need to settle everyday matters, do you appoint as judges those of no standing in the church?
1Co.6.4.kjv: If then ye have judgments of things pertaining to this life, set them to judge who are least esteemed in the church.

1Co.6.5.bsb: I say this to your shame. Is there really no one among you wise enough to arbitrate between his brothers?
1Co.6.5.kjv: I speak to your shame. Is it so, that there is not a wise man among you? no, not one that shall be able to judge between his brethren?

1Co.6.6.bsb: Instead, one brother goes to law against another, and this in front of unbelievers!
1Co.6.6.kjv: But brother goeth to law with brother, and that before the unbelievers.

1Co.6.7.bsb: The very fact that you have lawsuits among you means that you are thoroughly defeated already. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be cheated?
1Co.6.7.kjv: Now therefore there is utterly a fault among you, because ye go to law one with another. Why do ye not rather take wrong? why do ye not rather suffer yourselves to be defrauded?

1Co.11.17.bsb: In the following instructions I have no praise to offer, because your gatherings do more harm than good.
1Co.11.17.kjv: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.

1Co.11.19.bsb: And indeed, there must be differences among you to show which of you are approved.
1Co.11.19.kjv: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.

1Co.1.4.bsb: I always thank my God for you because of the grace He has given you in Christ Jesus.
1Co.1.4.kjv: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;

1Co.11.4.bsb: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.
1Co.11.4.kjv: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.

1Co.11.13.bsb: Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?
1Co.11.13.kjv: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?

1Co.15.3.bsb: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
1Co.15.3.kjv: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;

1Co.9.10.bsb: Isn’t He actually speaking on our behalf? Indeed, this was written for us, because when the plowman plows and the thresher threshes, they should also expect to share in the harvest.
1Co.9.10.kjv: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.

1Co.14.37.bsb: If anyone considers himself a prophet or spiritual person, let him acknowledge that what I am writing you is the Lord’s command.
1Co.14.37.kjv: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.

1Co.1.22.bsb: Jews demand signs and Greeks search for wisdom,
1Co.1.22.kjv: For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:

1Co.3.6.bsb: I planted the seed and Apollos watered it, but God made it grow.
1Co.3.6.kjv: I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.

1Co.3.7.bsb: So neither he who plants nor he who waters is anything, but only God, who makes things grow.
1Co.3.7.kjv: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.

1Co.11.20.bsb: Now then, when you come together, it is not the Lord’s Supper you eat.
1Co.11.20.kjv: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord’s supper.

1Co.11.21.bsb: For as you eat, each of you goes ahead without sharing his meal. While one remains hungry, another gets drunk.
1Co.11.21.kjv: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.

1Co.11.27.bsb: Therefore, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.
1Co.11.27.kjv: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.

1Co.14.36.bsb: Did the word of God originate with you? Or are you the only ones it has reached?
1Co.14.36.kjv: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?

1Co.14.38.bsb: But if anyone ignores this, he himself will be ignored.
1Co.14.38.kjv: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.

1Co.10.25.bsb: Eat anything sold in the meat market without raising questions of conscience,
1Co.10.25.kjv: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:

1Co.10.27.bsb: If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you want to go, eat anything set before you without raising questions of conscience.
1Co.10.27.kjv: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.

1Co.16.4.bsb: And if it is advisable for me to go also, they can travel with me.
1Co.16.4.kjv: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.

1Co.9.2.bsb: Even if I am not an apostle to others, surely I am to you. For you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
1Co.9.2.kjv: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.

1Co.11.25.bsb: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood; do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me.”
1Co.11.25.kjv: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.

1Co.9.8.bsb: Do I say this from a human perspective? Doesn’t the Law say the same thing?
1Co.9.8.kjv: Say I these things as a man? or saith not the law the same also?

1Co.14.31.bsb: For you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged.
1Co.14.31.kjv: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.

1Co.14.39.bsb: So, my brothers, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.
1Co.14.39.kjv: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.

1Co.10.18.bsb: Consider the people of Israel: Are not those who eat the sacrifices fellow partakers in the altar?
1Co.10.18.kjv: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?

1Co.10.29.bsb: the other one’s conscience, I mean, not your own. For why should my freedom be determined by someone else’s conscience?
1Co.10.29.kjv: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man’s conscience?

1Co.3.5.bsb: What then is Apollos? And what is Paul? They are servants through whom you believed, as the Lord has assigned to each his role.
1Co.3.5.kjv: Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers by whom ye believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?

1Co.9.4.bsb: Have we no right to food and to drink?
1Co.9.4.kjv: Have we not power to eat and to drink?

1Co.10.23.bsb: “Everything is permissible,” but not everything is beneficial. “Everything is permissible,” but not everything is edifying.
1Co.10.23.kjv: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.

1Co.9.12.bsb: If others have this right to your support, shouldn’t we have it all the more? But we did not exercise this right. Instead, we put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel of Christ.
1Co.9.12.kjv: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.

1Co.4.8.bsb: Already you have all you want. Already you have become rich. Without us, you have become kings. How I wish you really were kings, so that we might be kings with you!
1Co.4.8.kjv: Now ye are full, now ye are rich, ye have reigned as kings without us: and I would to God ye did reign, that we also might reign with you.

1Co.4.10.bsb: We are fools for Christ, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You are honored, but we are dishonored.
1Co.4.10.kjv: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but ye are wise in Christ; we are weak, but ye are strong; ye are honourable, but we are despised.

1Co.11.23.bsb: For I received from the Lord what I also passed on to you: The Lord Jesus, on the night He was betrayed, took bread,
1Co.11.23.kjv: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:

1Co.11.32.bsb: But when we are judged by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned with the world.
1Co.11.32.kjv: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.

1Co.4.17.bsb: That is why I have sent you Timothy, my beloved and faithful child in the Lord. He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus, which is exactly what I teach everywhere in every church.
1Co.4.17.kjv: For this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in the Lord, who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ, as I teach every where in every church.

1Co.3.18.bsb: Let no one deceive himself. If any of you thinks he is wise in this age, he should become a fool, so that he may become wise.
1Co.3.18.kjv: Let no man deceive himself. If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world, let him become a fool, that he may be wise.

1Co.4.9.bsb: For it seems to me that God has displayed us apostles at the end of the procession, like prisoners appointed for death. We have become a spectacle to the whole world, to angels as well as to men.
1Co.4.9.kjv: For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last, as it were appointed to death: for we are made a spectacle unto the world, and to angels, and to men.
